headline: ⏰ **NOT ONE NEW SHOWING, FEEDBACK FORM OR REQUEST HAS COME THROUGH SINCE MONDAY EVENING** — the last event on this board is 38 hours old, and that is the honest read rather than a quiet one. 📥 **THE WHOLE BOARD NOW HANGS ON ONE REPLY YOU OWE:** the agent who sent the buyer-signed offer on 225 Willow Point asked in writing to be told it arrived and has been waiting since 2:20 yesterday afternoon. ⭐ **AND THERE IS A SECOND LIVE PARTY ON THAT SAME HOUSE WHO DOES NOT KNOW AN OFFER EXISTS** — she came back on her own Tuesday morning saying her buyer is forwarding it to a husband who works out of town. ⚠️ Behind Willow Point the calendar is empty: nothing is booked ahead on any listing, and the Saturday read on 2368 Ridge Trail is now four days outstanding.

hotSignals.signal: 📥 **OFFER IN HAND, BUYER SIGNED BEFORE THE SELLER EVER SAW IT — AND 18 HOURS LATER THE AGENT WHO SENT IT HAS STILL NOT HEARD BACK.** Molly G. of Keller Williams Hoover emailed the full packet at 2:20:39 PM — purchase agreement with the buyer's signature on it, personal-property addendum, FHA addendum and a lender pre-approval — then texted ninety seconds later to be sure it was seen, and wrote *“Let me know that you have received.”* 🎯 The offered price is NOT known to this board and was not guessed: it lives inside the PDF and no lane here can open an attachment.
hotSignals.action: Open the PDF and read the actual price, then answer her — by voice first, and correct the flood figure in the same conversation. The written reply is already drafted and waiting on your send.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 **A THIRD AGENT CAME BACK ON HER OWN AND STILL DOES NOT KNOW AN OFFER EXISTS.** Angela W. of ARC Realty 280 — whose buyer toured Sunday and left in under ten minutes — wrote unprompted at 5:51 Tuesday morning calling it *“an adorable townhouse”* and said her buyer is forwarding the listing to a husband who works out of town. ⭐ THAT READ AS CLUTTER ON SUNDAY AND IT IS LEVERAGE TODAY: the offer in hand is FHA with a pre-approval written to exactly list price, which leaves zero headroom if the appraisal lands short.
hotSignals.action: Call her today and tell her an offer is in hand, with a same-day window for her buyer. You can work the first offer clean after asking — you cannot un-ask on Friday.

hotSignals.signal: 🎉 **THE FIRST FEEDBACK THIS ADDRESS EVER PRODUCED, AND THE HEADLINE WAS WHAT SHE DIDN'T SAY.** Anna C. of A2 Properties toured and filed a form that never challenged the price — across four tours and three brokerages, not one agent has argued the number. 🔍 That is what a correctly priced listing looks like once the marketing finds the buyers.
hotSignals.action: Nothing owed — Gene answered her himself and her reply is already in the thread. Carried as the pricing receipt behind today's negotiation.

hotSignals.signal: 🎯 **A FIFTH SHOWING SATURDAY AT 3:00 PM FROM AN AGENT WHO HAD NEVER SHOWN THIS HOUSE BEFORE — and the read has still not come back, four days on.** ⚠️ Separately, four independent agents have now filed the same verdict on this address: not interested, priced too high. The most recent added the worst staging score on this board and a lever that is not a price cut — a pre-inspection, because unknowns are exactly what one removes.
hotSignals.action: Chase Saturday's read once more, then stop chasing it — this address returns forms about half the time. The live buyer who put a specific number under the ask in writing is the one still uncalled.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 **THE ONLY UNQUALIFIED YES ON THIS BOARD, AND IT IS NOW DAY TWELVE.** Amy G. of Ethos International filed it herself: interested YES, her buyers just started looking, they really like it, and it sits at the TOP of their list. She phoned from inside the house mid-showing, so a call back is returned, not cold. ⭐ SHE LEFT PRICED RIGHT BLANK — the objection is unasked, not absent, and only a person can ask it.
hotSignals.action: Human call, today. Twelve days is well past the window where a machine outreach is appropriate — and the basement lights she reported still have no answer from the seller.
